what_is_domination_index_di article_link:
It's the average of a team's placement relative to the other teams or their Performance Index.
It ranks a team's performance each leg from a scale from 0 to 1.
Purpose: This calculates the average fairly, scaling placements in each leg fairly.

Example: Team Guido/Joe and Bill placed 4th out of 9 teams in Leg 3 of TAR(US)1 and also placed 4th out of 4 teams in Leg 10. Normally, these placements will added and averaged equally, but it seems unfair to say that placing 4th/9 is just as good as placing 4th/4, so we need a system that scales last place out of four teams effectively.


















Perfomance Index Formula: [performance index] = 1 - (([leg placement] - 1)÷[# of teams on that leg])
Google Sheets Formula: =ROUND(MINUS(1, DIVIDE(MINUS([leg placement], 1), [# of teams on that leg])), 5
(Average these formulas ^ to get their Domination Index)
